subject: planner: handle histogram last bucket end value underrepresented (#62695)
summary: Diff introduces a heuristic to treat the last bucket’s end value (bucket upper bound) as potentially stale/underrepresented for EQ row-count estimation when post-ANALYZE changes are significant and the bucket-repeat count is far below the histogram’s average per-value count. It wires this into both column and index EQ estimation paths, factors out row-count-drift computation via `Histogram.AbsRowCountDifference`, and adds a focused unit test covering the intended scenario.
